notes: Read all 500 source lines line by line before editing. This is pure, non-visual command-palette data + the scoreCommand ranker (no JSX, Recharts, Leaflet, or DOM UI), so the registry data and scoring logic are ported 1:1 with React Native-safe substitutions only for the browser/web-only seams. Every source line was considered; coverage is whole-file.

L1-6 imports: web pulls six browser/web-only deps. L1 react-router-dom NavigateFunction -> native-safe `export type NavigateFunction = (path: string) => void` (every ctx.navigate call passes a single string path). L2 i18next TFunction -> native-safe overloaded `CommandTFunction` (+ `CommandTranslateOptions`) accepting the exact two call shapes used: t(key, defaultValue) and t(key, {defaultValue, ...interpolation}). L3 ModeId/ThemeId (@/components/ui/ThemeProvider) -> inlined verbatim unions (ThemeId: neon-cyan|tesla-red|matrix-green|royal-purple|solar-amber|custom; ModeId: dark|light|oled|midnight|auto|sunset|nord). L4+L8 Icons/LucideIcon (@/lib/icons, lucide DOM SVG) -> all 21 referenced icon concepts have a 1:1 match in the native SemanticIconName registry, so `icon` is typed SemanticIconName, re-exported as `LucideIcon` to preserve the `export type { LucideIcon }` surface, with a native-safe `Icons` concept->SemanticIconName shim so each entry keeps `icon: Icons.x` verbatim. L5 TOUR_OPEN_LAUNCHER_EVENT (@/lib/tourRegistry) -> inlined verbatim ('teslasync:tour:openLauncher', matches existing native HelpSegment port). L6 _resetFrecency (@/lib/commandFrecency) -> native-safe inline (see below).

L10-25 registry docblock + L63-67 default-commands docblock + L458-471 scoreCommand docblock: preserved verbatim (still accurate — the list stays pure data decoupled from React). Added a native-port preamble documenting every browser-seam substitution (contract rule 7).

L27 CommandSection -> ported verbatim ('actions'|'preferences'|'pages'|'vehicles'). L29-42 CommandContext: ported faithfully; `navigate`/`t` retyped to the native-safe projections above; ADDED `isDarkMode: boolean` as the native replacement for the web `document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')` DOM read in the toggle-mode command (React Native has no DOM, so the host supplies the live resolved dark flag). All other fields (setMode/setTheme/setVehicleId/invalidateAll/toast.success|error|info) verbatim. L44-61 CommandDefinition -> ported verbatim (id/labelKey/labelFallback/icon/section/keywords/shortcut/perform), icon doc note updated to 'native semantic icon name'.

L68-456 commandRegistry array: all 32 entries ported 1:1 — same ids (incl. the audit-pinned literal 'feedback.open' at web L340), labelKey, labelFallback, section, keywords (every keyword preserved), shortcuts (T/E/?), navigation paths (/notifications/studio, /alert-studio?test=1, /notifications/inbox, /command-history, /security-access, /system-status, /api-playground, /data-export, /settings, /dashboard), setMode/setTheme arguments, and toast text + i18n keys/interpolation. The 12 preferences + 20 actions sections and their section comments are preserved.

perform() browser seams converted: window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name)) (web L126/294/333/350/361/375/394/408/422/436) -> emitCommandEvent(name) on a module-level command-event bus (COMMAND_EVENT name table + emit/subscribe/__resetCommandEventsForTests), the native analog of the single global window bus (TimeMachineBanner/SessionExpiredModal precedent). EVERY event-name string is preserved verbatim: open-theme-popover, time-machine.open-picker, toggle-keyboard-shortcuts, open-feedback-modal, teslasync:tour:openLauncher, teslasync:changelog:open, dashboard:toggle-edit/open-switcher/add-widget/reset. window.setTimeout(...,50) (web L393/407/421/435) -> global setTimeout (preserves the navigate-then-defer-50ms 'wait for listener to mount' intent). A throwing host listener can't break dispatch (try/catch in emit).

L199-208 toggle-mode: `document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')` -> `const isDark = ctx.isDarkMode` (host-supplied), then identical setMode(isDark?'light':'dark') + toast.info with the same two i18n keys (theme.switchedToLight/theme.switchedToDark) and English fallbacks. L115-128 themePicker comment + L278-296 time-machine comment + L336-352 feedback comment + L364-377 changelog comment + L379-382 dashboard comment: retargeted from 'Layout listens / window event' to 'native host subscribes via subscribeCommandEvent' while keeping the behavioral intent.

L115-121 _resetFrecency (web localStorage.removeItem('teslasync:cmd-frecency:v1')) -> native-safe inline preserving the exact FRECENCY_STORAGE_KEY: feature-detects globalThis.localStorage (present on react-native-web, AIVoiceMode precedent) and removes the same key; on pure React Native (no localStorage) it is an explicit, documented no-op until the separate commandFrecency module is ported (contract rule 7). The 'action.frecency.reset' command otherwise preserves its toast.success + i18n key verbatim.

L472-500 scoreCommand: ported verbatim — same 7-tier heuristic (exact 1000; prefix 500+len; substring 200+len; acronym via /[\s\-_/:.]+/ split first-letters 150; keyword prefix 100 / substring 50; subsequence 25; else 0), same empty/whitespace -> 1 guard. Only prettier reformatting (arrowParens 'avoid', single quotes, multi-line if blocks) — no logic change.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide-react, react-router-dom, i18next, or old web UI components are imported (only a type-only `import type { SemanticIconName }` from the native SemanticIcon, fully erased at runtime). No unit-suffixed Go-field or @deprecated legacy-converter concerns apply (no units in this file). Added focused Jest coverage at apps/native/__tests__/commandRegistry.test.ts (scoreCommand tiers, 32-command/unique-id/icon-validity registry checks, the event-bus subscribe/emit/unsubscribe + throwing-listener contract, and perform side effects incl. toggle-mode/refresh/navigation/feedback emit/dashboard deferred-emit/frecency localStorage clear). Gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck, npm run lint -- --quiet, npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
